title: Bind each check to what it checked
statement: Tie every check's result to the digest of the build and screen it checked, so a relevant change withdraws the result and reruns the affected checks.
example: A package downloaded earlier matched 0 of 55 current lesson digests.
detail: The reading course's quality gates hold one pinned build per round, because changes landing on the main branch mid-round invalidated in-progress rounds three times (`grade3-reading/ti-courseplans/docs/key-quality-gates.md`, lines 148-149). Its quality standard makes every evidence record carry artifact and dependency digests, so that a relevant change forces the affected checks to rerun (`grade3-reading/ti-courseplans/docs/standards/student-course-quality/versions/2.0.0/GOLDEN-CHECKLIST.qmd`, line 35). A package downloaded earlier matched 0 of 55 lesson digests and 0 of 7 showcase digests in the current build, and was barred from reuse as a source. Review one frozen, pinned build at a time, and compare versions only on the same base.
against: The standard bounds the rule: unrelated changes need not invalidate scoped evidence (`grade3-reading/ti-courseplans/docs/standards/student-course-quality/versions/1.0.0/STANDARD.qmd`, line 216).
